records.name: Bomber DX

supported_fields.mechanics: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user charges the Ki wave for about a second, then fires a purple mid-range blast from the left hand for a single-hit knockback attack. Current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence reports about 15% damage and confirms that Bomber DX can absorb/cancel incoming Ki Blasts, including charged Ki Blasts. The documented in-game warning is a long activation period.

records.name: Break Cannon

supported_fields.mechanics: 300+ Ki Ki Blast Ultimate. The user cracks their knuckles and fires a mid-range beam from the mouth. It can hit up to 15 times; current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence reports about 15% base damage over the 15-hit sequence, with results varying according to the amount of Ki stored. The move is learned from Nappa's Lesson 3.

records.name: Endless Shoot

supported_fields.mechanics: 100+ Ki Ki Blast Super. The user jumps back and fires a straight barrage of Ki beams. The base sequence fires 5 blasts for about 10% damage; holding the input consumes additional Ki, up to 400 extra, allowing up to 19 blasts and about 30% total damage. The target can be changed while the barrage is active. The skill's listed base cost is 100 Ki.

records.name: Evil Explosion

supported_fields.mechanics: 100-Ki Ki Blast Super. The user charges energy in both fists and releases a short-range yellow blast. The attack has three charge stages, increasing its effective range; current Xenoverse 2-specific evidence also documents that a fully charged Level 3 use can teleport a Super Saiyan user to the opponent before firing. The attack deals high stamina damage on block at full charge. The skill remains Piccolo's Initiation Test reward.
